message.content:
{
  "maturity": "initial",
  "focalEvent": {
    "label": "Air interruption at RHOB service station (header H-R) during boundary preparation for WO-527",
    "detail": "At approximately 10:00 AM on May 20, an air-low indication appeared at the receiving header H-R while a two-person Utilities crew was preparing to accept maintenance. Work paused and pressure restored by ~10:07 without authorized line opening.",
    "status": "verified",
    "sourceIds": [
      "incident-description"
    ],
    "specialistIds": []
  },
  "nodes": [
    {
      "key": "boundary-prep-state",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Maintenance boundary preparation in progress; acceptance signature pending on WO-527 cover.",
      "detail": "Crew U-A/U-B were at the gallery preparing to accept boundary. The work package cover shows ECP issued but no signed maintenance release and a blank temporary instruction field.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "36f83919-8b7a-4ec0-a789-5d3e24cdaf6f#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "procedure-documentation-gap",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "No approved temporary instruction recorded on WO-527 cover; physical presence unknown.",
      "detail": "The work package cover field for temporary instructions is blank. Record conventions state an empty field records no value, but do not prove absence of a physically attached document.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "4df0cf7c-f4aa-49ea-a08a-ea4cd74d41f2#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "valve-state-unknown",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Valve states (M-101/M-102 and others) at RHOB service station are unknown.",
      "detail": "The area directory lists valve identifiers but explicitly does not establish current positions or pressure availability. No field log records specific actions taken on valves between 09:48 and 10:07.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "aa0527b9-a6e3-4782-bb4e-b6cc9eb9dbcc#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "upstream-status-unknown",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Status of upstream air source and distribution system between P-U and H-R is unknown.",
      "detail": "No pressure trace or alarm history exists to determine if the interruption originated at the compressor, within the gallery/distribution line, or downstream at H-R.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "0bcc8d12-7f2d-4d73-a6ee-5fefc55c7c84#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "no-supervision-record",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "No record of supervisor verification or physical valve-state check before the interruption.",
      "detail": "The shift log does not indicate a supervisor verified boundary conditions. The directory states maintenance release requires acceptance, but absence of signature alone is ambiguous without evidence that supervision occurred.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "36f83919-8b7a-4ec0-a789-5d3e24cdaf6f#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "change-disposition-status",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Engineering disposition for any service-routing change affecting the boundary is unknown.",
      "detail": "Change requirements state that if a routing change affects an existing maintenance boundary, engineering disposition must occur before use. No record confirms whether such changes were disposed of or documented prior to 10:00.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "26552941-efa6-4cf3-bb10-337c6e62531d#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "simops-context",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "No record of simultaneous operations (SIMOPS) or contractor activity near H-R.",
      "detail": "The evidence packet does not contain logs indicating other crews, contractors, or external work in the area that could have caused valve closures or line openings.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "stored-energy-status",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Status of accumulators, backfeed paths, or residual pressure sources is unknown.",
      "detail": "No P&ID review or drain/blowdown log entries are provided to determine if stored energy could have caused a transient low-pressure condition without source failure.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "crew-briefing-status",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Crew U-A/U-B may not have received briefing on recent changes to 1SC dryer group or RHOB service station.",
      "detail": "The training extract does not state which configuration drawing the crew saw, nor whether they received a change briefing. This is unknown but relevant if an outdated procedure was used.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fda75553-eef9-44a7-b3e0-2457fab694d9#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "maintenance-receiver-presence",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Maintenance receiver M-A presence and acceptance actions at the field are unknown.",
      "detail": "M-A holds dryer-maintenance qualification but boundary acceptance was pending. No record confirms if M-A was physically present or refused to accept a non-normal state without documentation.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fda75553-eef9-44a7-b3e0-2457fab694d9#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "physical-temporary-instruction",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Physical presence of an approved temporary instruction attached to WO-527 is unknown.",
      "detail": "The cover field is blank, but record conventions state empty fields do not prove absence. Physical attachment would determine if the crew had an authorized procedure for the current energy-control state.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "4df0cf7c-f4aa-49ea-a08a-ea4cd74d41f2#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "valve-operation-event",
      "type": "event",
      "label": "Valves M-101/M-102 or other isolation valves were manipulated (open/closed) between 09:48 and 10:07.",
      "detail": "This event is hypothesized as a potential cause but lacks direct evidence. The crew was preparing boundary, implying valve operations occurred, but specific actions are undocumented.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "upstream-failure-event",
      "type": "event",
      "label": "Upstream air source or distribution system experienced a failure (trip, valve closure) at ~10:00.",
      "detail": "Hypothesized cause if P-U was normal while H-R dropped. No evidence confirms this mechanism yet; requires pressure trace comparison.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "downstream-failure-event",
      "type": "event",
      "label": "Receiving header H-R or downstream equipment failed (leak, valve failure) causing air loss.",
      "detail": "Hypothesized cause if upstream was normal. No evidence confirms this mechanism yet; requires inspection of H-R components.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "stored-energy-release-event",
      "type": "event",
      "label": "Stored energy (accumulator, backfeed) released causing transient low pressure.",
      "detail": "Hypothesized cause if no source failure occurred. Requires verification of drain/blowdown procedures and valve positions to confirm or reject.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "unauthorized-line-opening-event",
      "type": "event",
      "label": "An unauthorized line opening occurred during boundary preparation.",
      "detail": "Hypothesized cause if crew opened a valve not in scope. No evidence supports this; logs state no authorized line opening, but physical actions are unknown.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "specialistIds": []
    },
    {
      "key": "barrier-missing-1",
      "type": "condition",
      "label": "Barrier: Valid, approved procedure (ECP or temporary instruction) was not physically present to guide valve operations.",
      "detail": "If the blank field on WO-527 cover means no physical document existed and ECP Rev3 did not apply without a change disposition, this barrier failed. Status depends on whether an unrecorded temp instruction existed.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "4df0cf7c-f4aa-49ea-a08a-ea4cd74d41f2#1"
      ],
      "specialistIds": []
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "boundary-prep-state",
      "toKey": "valve-operation-event",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Boundary preparation implies valve operations occurred. If valves were manipulated without proper procedure or authorization, this could cause air loss.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "36f83919-8b7a-4ec0-a789-5d3e24cdaf6f#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no valve operations occurred, the air loss must have another cause (upstream failure or downstream equipment issue).",
      "competingExplanation": "Upstream source failure independent of crew actions.",
      "evidenceGap": "Field log entries recording specific valve positions and timestamps between 09:48–10:07."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "boundary-prep-state",
      "toKey": "procedure-documentation-gap",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The blank temporary instruction field on WO-527 cover suggests no approved procedure was recorded. If this gap persisted physically, it could enable unsafe valve operations.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "4df0cf7c-f4aa-49ea-a08a-ea4cd74d41f2#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If an approved temporary instruction was physically attached despite the blank field, this barrier would not have failed.",
      "competingExplanation": "Physical document existed but was unrecorded on cover copy; record conventions allow for this possibility.",
      "evidenceGap": "Photograph or scan of WO-527 work folder interior showing any attached temporary instruction."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "procedure-documentation-gap",
      "toKey": "barrier-missing-1",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "If no approved procedure was physically present, the barrier of 'valid guidance for valve operations' is missing. This could lead to incorrect boundary state.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "4df0cf7c-f4aa-49ea-a08a-ea4cd74d41f2#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If an approved procedure was present, the barrier would not have failed.",
      "competingExplanation": "Crew used ECP Rev3 without needing a temporary instruction because no change affected the boundary; this requires engineering disposition evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "Confirmation of whether any service-routing changes required disposition before 10:00."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "valve-state-unknown",
      "toKey": "upstream-status-unknown",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Unknown valve states at RHOB could interact with unknown upstream status to cause air loss. Without knowing which valves were open/closed, we cannot determine if a downstream closure or upstream failure caused the event.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "aa0527b9-a6e3-4782-bb4e-b6cc9eb9dbcc#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If valve states were known and upstream status was normal, the cause would be downstream equipment failure or procedural error.",
      "competingExplanation": "Upstream source failure independent of local valve states.",
      "evidenceGap": "Pressure trace for P-U vs H-R; field log entries recording specific valve positions."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "valve-state-unknown",
      "toKey": "downstream-failure-event",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "If valves were closed or equipment failed downstream of P-U, this could cause air loss at H-R while upstream remained normal.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no valve closure occurred and no equipment failure existed, the cause must be upstream or stored energy release.",
      "competingExplanation": "Upstream source failure causing simultaneous drop at P-U (if recorded).",
      "evidenceGap": "Inspection of H-R components; field log entries recording specific valve positions."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "valve-state-unknown",
      "toKey": "unauthorized-line-opening-event",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "If crew opened a line not in scope or closed an isolation valve incorrectly, this could cause air loss. Unknown valve states prevent confirming this.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no unauthorized opening occurred and valves were correctly positioned per procedure, the cause must be upstream or equipment failure.",
      "competingExplanation": "Upstream source failure independent of crew actions.",
      "evidenceGap": "Field log entries recording specific valve positions; witness testimony from U-A/U-B."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "upstream-status-unknown",
      "toKey": "stored-energy-release-event",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "If upstream status was normal but stored energy (accumulator, backfeed) released unexpectedly, this could cause transient low pressure. Unknown upstream status prevents confirming or rejecting this.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no stored energy sources were active and drain/blowdown procedures followed, the cause must be source failure or valve operation error.",
      "competingExplanation": "Upstream source failure causing sustained low pressure rather than transient dip.",
      "evidenceGap": "P&ID showing accumulator locations; drain/blowdown log entries."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "no-supervision-record",
      "toKey": "barrier-missing-1",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "Absence of supervisor verification or physical valve-state check could enable unsafe boundary preparation. If supervision was absent, the barrier of 'verified conditions' is missing.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "36f83919-8b7a-4ec0-a789-5d3e24cdaf6f#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a supervisor verified valve states before release, the barrier would not have failed.",
      "competingExplanation": "Supervision occurred but was not recorded; crew followed procedure without documented verification.",
      "evidenceGap": "Interview with supervisors or field verification logs."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "change-disposition-status",
      "toKey": "procedure-documentation-gap",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "If a service-routing change affected the boundary and engineering disposition did not occur, an approved temporary instruction would be required. Absence of such record suggests potential gap.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "26552941-efa6-4cf3-bb10-337c6e62531d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no change affected the boundary, ECP Rev3 would suffice without a temporary instruction.",
      "competingExplanation": "Change occurred but was disposed of; record not captured in evidence packet.",
      "evidenceGap": "Change control system records for ECP-1SC-04 and related drawings."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "crew-briefing-status",
      "toKey": "procedure-documentation-gap",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "If crew did not receive briefing on recent changes, they may have used an outdated procedure or incorrect valve configuration. This could lead to air loss.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fda75553-eef9-44a7-b3e0-2457fab694d9#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If crew received briefing and used correct procedure, the gap would not have caused air loss.",
      "competingExplanation": "Briefing occurred but was ineffective; outdated drawing still in use despite change notification.",
      "evidenceGap": "Change notification log for ECP-1SC-04 Rev3 or related drawings."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "maintenance-receiver-presence",
      "toKey": "boundary-prep-state",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "If M-A was absent or refused to accept boundary without proper documentation, this could explain why work proceeded unsafely. Unknown presence prevents confirming this.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fda75553-eef9-44a7-b3e0-2457fab694d9#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If M-A was present and accepted boundary with proper documentation, the state would be authorized.",
      "competingExplanation": "M-A was absent but work proceeded under emergency exception not recorded; requires evidence of such policy.",
      "evidenceGap": "Attendance log for shift; interview with M-A."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "physical-temporary-instruction",
      "toKey": "barrier-missing-1",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "If no physical temporary instruction existed, the barrier of 'valid procedure for current energy-control state' is missing. This could lead to incorrect valve operations.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "4df0cf7c-f4aa-49ea-a08a-ea4cd74d41f2#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If an approved temporary instruction was physically attached, the barrier would not have failed.",
      "competingExplanation": "Temporary instruction existed but was unrecorded on cover copy; record conventions allow for this possibility.",
      "evidenceGap": "Photograph or scan of WO-527 work folder interior showing any attached temporary instruction."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "barrier-missing-1",
      "toKey": "focalEvent",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "If the barrier of 'valid procedure' was missing, this could enable unsafe valve operations leading to air loss. However, other causes (upstream failure) must be ruled out first.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "4df0cf7c-f4aa-49ea-a08a-ea4cd74d41f2#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the barrier was present (valid procedure existed), air loss would not have occurred due to procedural error.",
      "competingExplanation": "Upstream source failure independent of local barriers; requires pressure trace evidence.",
      "evidenceGap": "Pressure trace for P-U vs H-R; confirmation of whether any change required disposition before 10:00."
    }
  ],
  "questions": [
    {
      "intent": "determine-if-the-interruption-occurred-upstream-source-distribution-or-at-h-r-re",
      "text": "What evidence shows where the air-low indication originated: source, distribution line, or RHOB receiving header?",
      "rationale": "Locating origin distinguishes whether Utilities operations missed a release condition versus an external supply event.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "alarm input mapping",
        "point register for H-R and upstream headers"
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "routedTo": []
    },
    {
      "intent": "confirm-whether-a-temporary-instruction-was-actually-attached-to-wo-527-despite-",
      "text": "Was any approved temporary instruction physically attached to the work folder for air-service changes during this preparation?",
      "rationale": "Section 3.6 requires an issued ECP revision or approved temporary instruction; absence may indicate incomplete change disposition.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "work folder contents",
        "temporary instruction attachment log"
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "routedTo": []
    },
    {
      "intent": "determine-if-the-air-interruption-was-caused-by-a-physical-valve-state-change-op",
      "text": "What specific valves were open, closed, or in transition at RHOB service station and North gallery between 09:48 and 10:07?",
      "rationale": "The directory lists M-101/M-102 as main-route valves but does not record their state. Knowing which valve(s) were manipulated explains the loss of pressure at H-R.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Field observation log",
        "field photograph, or control-system history showing valve positions and timestamps"
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "routedTo": []
    },
    {
      "intent": "determine-if-the-air-interruption-originated-upstream-north-gallery-within-distr",
      "text": "Did indication P-U show a low-pressure condition simultaneously with or before the alarm at H-R?",
      "rationale": "If P-U was normal while H-R dropped, the failure is likely downstream of P-U. If both were abnormal, the source may be upstream (air header).",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Historical pressure trace for P-U and H-R",
        "Control-system alarm history"
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "routedTo": []
    },
    {
      "intent": "verify-physical-presence-of-temporary-instruction",
      "text": "Was an approved temporary instruction physically attached to the WO-527 work folder despite the blank field on the cover copy?",
      "rationale": "The cover shows a blank attachment field, but record conventions state that empty fields do not prove absence of physical documents. Physical presence would determine whether the crew had an authorized procedure for the current energy-control state.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Photograph or scan of the inside front page of WO-527 work folder showing any attached temporary instruction",
        "Witness testimony from U-A/U-B regarding what documents were in their possession at 09:48–10:00"
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "routedTo": []
    },
    {
      "intent": "verify-boundary-release-status",
      "text": "Was the maintenance boundary formally released (signature obtained) before or during the air interruption at ~10:00 AM?",
      "rationale": "The cover shows signature pending. If release occurred via a separate record not captured on the cover, that would change whether work was authorized under an unrecorded state.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Signed maintenance acceptance sheet or electronic log showing boundary-release timestamp",
        "Interview with M-A (maintenance receiver) regarding when/where they signed off"
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "routedTo": []
    },
    {
      "intent": "verify-configuration-document-in-use",
      "text": "Which configuration drawing or energy-control procedure did the crew U-A/U-B use to guide valve operations during boundary preparation?",
      "rationale": "The area directory does not establish current piping. If an outdated or incorrect diagram was used, it could explain why valves were left in a state that caused air loss.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Copy of the drawing held by U-A/U-B at 09:48–10:00",
        "Revision history and distribution log for configuration drawings referenced on WO-527"
      ],
      "priority": "medium",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "routedTo": []
    },
    {
      "intent": "verify-valve-states-at-time-of-event",
      "text": "What were the open/closed states of main-route valves M-101/M-102 and any other isolation valves at RHOB service station when air pressure dropped?",
      "rationale": "Valve state determines whether a procedural error, equipment failure, or upstream event caused the interruption. Unknown valve states prevent causal analysis.",
      "evidenceNeeded": [
        "Field log entries from U-A/U-B recording valve positions",
        "Instrument record showing pressure trend and any manual override events"
      ],
      "priority": "high",
      "sourceIds": [],
